study.question: Does shared-weight prediction averaging over the supplied path and its reversal retain click utility better than content-selected path orientation, and at what measured cost? This isolates direction within the broader question of supplied order versus content; reversal invariance is not arbitrary-permutation invariance.
study.hypothesis: Observed supplied AUC 0.6685268680, globally reversed 0.6683840769, lexical 0.6659442302, and content-canonical open path 0.6663618642 leave a consequential ambiguity: per-row content-based direction selection may impair the fixed compressor/optimizer even when loss of directional information is avoidable. A two-element reversal orbit, averaged at four-task probabilities and trained as that predictor from scratch, removes direction without discontinuously choosing one orientation. It retains undirected adjacency and endpoints. It may recover utility relative to path canonicalization; this is an exploratory unverified local hypothesis, not a novelty or direction-irrelevance claim.

nearest_work.difference: Same complete-event tuples, valid positions and incumbent network; replace minimum-lexical orientation selection by shared-parameter evaluation of both directions with probability averaging.
Inherit all learned components and gradient gates. Add parameter-free two-view input construction and probability averaging. No new tower, learned routing, timestamp or field.

Primary archived section4.3 lines250-269 describes target-conditioned weighted sum pooling. Retain the adapted activation and incumbent compressed moments; this study concerns reversal symmetrization of the whole joint predictor, not a DIN reproduction or new attention claim.
Pinned benchmark forward lines132-172 uses unified sequence/nonsequence token interaction and readout; no such backbone adopted. No claim of equivalence to the original paper.
Pinned benchmark forward lines119-156 combines unified tokens and masked sequence pooling. Here only shared-weight two-view treatment changes; no field-specific FFN or cross-attention is introduced.

inherited_components: All incumbent embeddings, local activation/Dice modules, ten-block compression, target-match and five moment channels, residual adapters, context-history product corrections, task towers, initialization ordering and source-gradient gates
Frozen data identities, official_offline visibility, four task semantics, one-pass host recipe and default sum of four unweighted BCEs
Exact complete-tuple lexical ranking and _path_sources from g1-r0062-canonical_path; cyclic canonicalization is not needed
study.proposed_difference: For every external B-example batch create a single internal 2B-view batch and invoke the unchanged network once. Candidate views are (supplied,R(supplied)); controls are (supplied,supplied), (path,path), (lexical,lexical). Return half the sum of the corresponding probabilities in FP32, yielding B predictions; host labels, optimizer step count and sampling batch are unchanged. Both views share all parameters and the same one-update Dice populations. Every cell computes the same lexical/path/reversal source indices and performs equally shaped selected gathers. Reverse only valid events into original valid positions, moving every item/action field and all four eligibility masks together; retain invalid positions and target exactly. This deliberately changes internal normalization populations and compute, controlled through duplicated views, and does not assert matched measured compute merely from code.
predictions: If canonical direction selection is the main avoidable penalty, reversal_average will exceed path_duplicate and approach supplied_duplicate on full validation click AUC. A predeclared descriptive recovery is within 0.0005 AUC of supplied_duplicate; it is not a significance threshold.

At common nonzero trained-style weights reversal_average and path_duplicate are invariant to per-example valid-event reversal, whereas lexical_duplicate is invariant to arbitrary valid-event permutations. Supplied_duplicate is not required to be invariant.

All cells have expected unchanged 32192421 total,31793216 embedding,399205 dense parameters. Two-view work increases inference/training cost versus the imported single-view incumbent; actual time/memory/latency must be measured. A reversal-average quality gain alone does not justify deployment cost.
falsifiers: Native reversal-invariance, event eligibility conservation, target/padding preservation or finite backward failure invalidates interpretation before fitted scoring.

If reversal_average remains materially below supplied_duplicate (especially by more than0.0005 AUC) and does not beat path_duplicate, this implementation does not support canonicalization as the main avoidable penalty. This does not prove all direction-invariant models fail.

If supplied_duplicate fails to reproduce the single-view incumbent within ordinary numeric/optimization variation, altered normalization or arithmetic remains a confound; diagnose before attributing gaps to directional information.
Equal or better lexical_duplicate would falsify useful supplied order for this tested two-view architecture/recipe. Single seed outcomes cannot establish stable mechanism support.
alternative_explanations: Two-view shared BatchNorm/Dice populations, nonlinear probability averaging and gradient coupling can alter optimization and calibration; reversal-average versus supplied-duplicate bundles these consequences of enforcing the symmetry.
Canonical path chooses orientations correlated with categorical ID encoding, and its treatment changes partial-block compression. Its loss is not proof of a directional signal.
Reversal retains undirected order and endpoint cut; a successful reversal-invariant model does not show arbitrary order is useless. Lexical sorting itself changes locality and optimization.

No independent training seeds or user-cluster uncertainty are provided. Same-seed bridges across rounds are reproducibility checks, not independent repetitions. Adaptively selected validation contrasts can overfit.

Inherited auxiliary AUC is lower than DIN; click selection must not hide auxiliary regressions. Official offline feedback maturity and static snapshot/vocabulary assumptions limit production interpretation.
